Chez Lyft, notre raison d'être est de servir et de connecter. Lyft Urban Solutions conçoit, fabrique et exploite des systèmes de vélopartage dans plus de 50 villes à travers le monde, dont New York, Chicago, Londres, Barcelone, Mexico, Rio de Janeiro et Montréal. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde.
 Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en ingénierie de la qualité terrain, matériel pour se joindre à notre équipe Qualité terrain (Field Quality) à notre établissement de Longueuil. Une fois que nos vélos, vélos électriques, batteries et stations quittent l'usine, l'équipe Qualité terrain est responsable de leur comportement en conditions réelles : des millions de trajets, en toutes saisons, dans des villes partout dans le monde. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs en qualité terrain pour aider à détecter les problèmes matériels émergents, à en investiguer la cause profonde et à soutenir la mise en place de correctifs avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et des opérations dans les marchés. Vous passerez du temps en laboratoire à manipuler des pièces défaillantes, et tout autant dans les données à évaluer l'ampleur réelle d'un problème.
 Responsabilités : 
 Soutenir les analyses de défaillance sur des pièces retournées du terrain, y compris les demandes des clients entreprises, en participant au démontage, à l'inspection et aux essais électriques et en documentant les constats avec photos.
 Aider à surveiller les données terrain, comme les alertes des véhicules et des stations et les historiques de réparation, et signaler les problèmes émergents à l'équipe.
 Concevoir et mettre à jour des tableaux de bord et des requêtes pour suivre les indicateurs de fiabilité et l'avancement des mises à niveau.
 Participer aux campagnes de mise à niveau sur le terrain en aidant à repérer les unités touchées et en suivant l'avancement.
 Aider à réviser les PON de réparation et les guides de diagnostic utilisés par les mécaniciens des marchés, et proposer des améliorations.
 Contribuer aux enquêtes sur les défaillances terrain dans Jira, en collaboration avec les ingénieurs, pour l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives.
 Expérience : 
 Être inscrit ou inscrite à un programme de baccalauréat ou de maîtrise en génie mécanique, électrique, mécatronique ou industriel, ou dans un domaine connexe, dans une université canadienne, avec une fin d'études prévue entre décembre 2027 et l'été 2028 (obligatoire) . Les personnes à la maîtrise ayant travaillé entre leurs deux programmes doivent cumuler moins de 2 ans d'expérience à temps plein.
 Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais , à l'écrit comme à l'oral (obligatoire)
 Aisance à manipuler du matériel électromécanique, notamment le démontage, l'inspection et le dépannage électrique de base avec des outils comme un multimètre
 Solides compétences analytiques et aisance à travailler avec de grands ensembles de données imparfaits pour en tirer des conclusions claires
 Connaissance des méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes (5 pourquoi, diagramme d'Ishikawa, 8D, AMDEC)
 Curiosité, souci du détail et communication écrite claire

 Love Python and want to share their knowledge to help learners level up

Senior Direct Response Creative Strategist
 Full-Time · Remote · Health & Supplement Brand (7-Figure)
 We're a 7-figure health and supplement brand looking for a senior creative strategist to own our direct response ad creative. 
This is not an agency role. You're joining the brand, working directly with the founders and operators, and building something long-term.
 The opportunity here is rare: you'll be working alongside high-level operators who will actively copy chief your work, sharpen your strategy thinking, and teach you systems that are scaling accounts past $100k/day. 
You will learn more in 90 days here than most strategists learn in two years at an agency. And the financial upside matches — top performers in this role will earn $50k-$200k+ per month.
 WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO
 •  Own creative strategy for the brand — angle ideation, market research, brief development, script writing, and ad account analysis
 •  Produce 15 briefs per week across multiple product lines and funnels
 •  Lead daily research using GetHooked, AdSpy, and the Meta Ads Library to find fresh angles before they saturate
 •  Review and quality-check briefs from junior strategists — you're the senior creative voice on the team
 •  Collaborate with editors through Asana and Frame.io to make sure production runs tight and fast
 •  Bridge the gap between media buying and creative by reviewing live performance data and feeding learnings back into new concepts
 •  Over time, build out your own creative pod with direct reports — essentially running your own business inside the business
 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
 •  Learn from the best: You'll be working directly with operators who have scaled multiple brands to 8-9 figures. Your work gets copy chiefed by people who actually know what converts. This level of mentorship doesn't exist at most brands or agencies.
 •  Real financial upside: Base compensation of $5,000-$10,000+/month depending on experience, plus 3%-5% of spend on every creative you produce. Top performers earn $50k-$200k+ per month.
 •  Growth path: Build your own pod, manage your own team, and grow into a leadership position with equity and profit-share conversations on the table.
 •  Creative ownership: Full authority over angles, concepts, and briefs. No committees, no bureaucracy.
 •  AI-first environment: Dedicated AI operations manager building tools and automations that plug directly into your workflow.
 WHO YOU ARE
 •  4+ years in direct response creative strategy, with hands-on experience in health, wellness, or supplements specifically
 •  You've produced at least one ad that crossed $100k in spend in a single month
 •  Fluent in Meta Ads Manager across every metric that matters: CPA, nCPA, hook rate, CTR, AOV, RPV, cohort data
 •  You know how to use GetHooked, AdSpy, and the Meta Ads Library as real research tools — not things you've just logged into
 •  Your background is in video and direct response. You understand what makes a VSL or native ad convert at scale. This is not a UGC role.
 •  Experience managing and developing junior strategists — giving feedback, assigning work, and raising the bar on output quality
 •  You thrive in lean, fast environments where the standard is performance, not process
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 •  30 days: You know the brand, the products, the winning angles, and the audience inside out. You're producing briefs daily and contributing to performance reviews.
 •  60 days: Your creatives are live, winners are getting iterated fast, and the junior strategists around you have a clearer sense of direction because of your leadership.
 •  90 days: Output is consistent, creative performance is measurable and trending up, and you're beginning to build your own pod.
 HOW TO APPLY
 Send us your portfolio or examples of ads you've produced that scaled past $100k in spend. Tell us which health/supplement brands you've worked with, what your highest-spending creative was, and why you want this role. 
WE WILL NOT LOOK AT YOUR PORTFOLIO IF YOU DO NOT ATTACH SPEND RESULTS
 COMPENSATION
 Base $5,000–$10,000/mo; senior $10,000+ depending on experience. Plus performance incentive of 3–5% of spend.

 Most job ads read like they were written by HR. 
Bullet points. Buzzwords. 
A "competitive compensation package" that translates to "we'll pay you just enough to keep you from leaving, but never enough to actually win." 
 This isn't that.
 This is a letter. From us to you. About one of the most lopsided opportunities we've ever put in front of a salesperson and the rare, specific human being we're trying to find to fill it.
 If that human is you, you're going to feel it in your chest somewhere around paragraph nine.
 First — Who We Are. And Why It Matters. 
 We're Wealth Without Wall Street. 
 Russ Morgan and Joey Muré built this from scratch, not in a Manhattan glass tower, not with a hedge-fund pedigree, but by getting fed up watching hardworking business owners hand their financial futures to suit-wearing strangers who couldn't pick them out of a lineup.
 Together we've helped thousands of business owners, real estate investors, doctors, and high-earning professionals do what 99% of America has been brainwashed into believing is impossible:
 Generate passive income that exceeds their monthly expenses. 
 That's the whole game. That's what freedom actually looks like — not a 401(k) you can't touch until you're 65 and your knees are gone, but real cash flowing in every single month whether you work or not.
 We do it using the Infinite Banking Concept — the same wealth strategy quietly used by the richest families in America for over a century. We teach people to become their own bank. To recycle their capital. To stop renting money from institutions that profit off their ignorance.
 Russ and Joey have done it themselves. Over $50,000 per month in passive income. Co-authors of an Amazon bestseller. Hosts of one of the most respected podcasts in personal finance.
 This isn't theory. This is the real thing.
 Right now, we have more qualified people waving their hands than we can possibly talk to.
 That's where you come in.
 The Role: Business Developer. (Translation: The Person Who Decides Who Gets Free.) 
 Let us describe a typical day so you know exactly what you're signing up for.
 You wake up. You check your calendar. There are real, pre-qualified humans on it, people who registered for our workshops, devoured Russ and Joey's content, raised their hand, and said "I want a Passive Income Game Plan Session." 
 These aren't cold strangers. 
These aren't leads scraped off a list. 
These are people who already trust the brand, already believe the philosophy, and already know they're tired of the rat race.
 Your job is to pickup the phone, set appointments by making outbound calls and take inbound appointments.
Ask the kind of questions most salespeople are too soft to ask. 
Find out where they really are financially, emotionally, mentally. Diagnose whether IBC and our path is actually right for them.
 And if it is? You hand them the keys.
 You're not pitching. You're not pressuring. You're not chasing.
 You're the bridge between someone's current life — exhausted, overworked, financially fragile — and the version of their life where they sleep through the night because money is finally working for them instead of against them.
 That's the job.
 If that sounds like too much responsibility, the back button is right there.
 Who We Are NOT Looking For.

 We are not looking for the guy who calls himself a "closer" because he sold timeshares in Cabo for six months.
 We are not looking for the person who needs a six-week ramp, a personal coach, three resource Slack channels, and a "psychologically safe" environment to dial a phone.

 Coachable ego. Strong opinions, loosely held. We promote killers who listen. We fire prima donnas who don't.

 Elite-level sales coaching from closers who've done eight figures in this exact niche.

 Pre-qualified, warm inbound leads — not cold lists, not scraped data, not random dials.

 ·       Solide experience gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement 
 ·       Bilingue

Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50 https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/about/press-room/deloitte-canada-announces-its-annual-technology-fast-50tm-program-winners.html). We invite you to read our startup story https://rewind.io/blog/why-we-started-rewind-backups/ to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here https://rewind.com/about-us/.
To find out more about our perks, click here https://rewind.com/careers/#:~:text=Working%20at%20Rewind%20has%20its%20perks.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

 - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About the role

This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales.

We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest.

We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way.

What you'll do

Launches and go-to-market

 - Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch.

 - Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones.

 - Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming.

 - Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change.

Positioning and messaging

 - Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas.

 - Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence.

 - Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work.

Buyer and competitive insight

 - Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions.

 - Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading.

 - Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market.

Sales and partner enablement

 - Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece.

 - Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work.

AI-powered product marketing

 - Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets.

 - Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse.

 - Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities.

What you'll bring

 - 4+ years of product marketing experience in B2B, including product launches, positioning and messaging.

 - Sales enablement experience, such as training sellers and building the battlecards and collateral they rely on.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, or a clear appetite to learn them fast. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach.

 - Experience working with product teams to define product strategy.

 - Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus.

 - Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling.

 - A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers.

 - Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in.

 - Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly.

 - Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Nice to have

 - Experience building AI workflows or automations for a marketing or sales team.



Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.



Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



The Machine Identity team builds the identity and access capabilities that securely connect AI agents and workloads to the systems they need. We make that access scoped and auditable, so individuals and teams can move beyond shared, long-lived credentials and understand which identity acted and on whose behalf.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027.



What You Can Expect:

 - Code, test, debug, deliver and maintain production software systems for new and existing product features.

 - Participate in planning by identifying tasks and breaking down, estimating, and planning work.

 - Write comprehensive tests during various stages of the development cycle, ensuring code is functioning as expected.

 - Review code for others to maintain high code quality, knowledge share within the team, and support creating a safe environment of giving and receiving feedback.

 - Generate and review documentation on code processes to ensure scalability.



What we're looking for:

 - Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion.

 - Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them).

 - Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are.

 - Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team!



Bonus points for:

 - Experience with a modern backend language (e.g. Go, Node.js, Ruby, or Python).

 - Understanding of authentication, authorization, and identity concepts (OAuth, OIDC, scoped access, policy enforcement)

 - Experience working with distributed systems, demonstrating best practices around monitoring, observability, performance and reliability
   
   

Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of most roles. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. 


How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

🏝 Generous PTO policy - 2.08 days per month (1.5 work weeks per 4 month term)
💖 Company-wide wellness days (1 per quarter) 
🌎 Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs
🏠 Remote-first environment
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
💡 1Password University access and learning sessions
🥳  Monthly internship events and socials



1Password is part of  Team True North https://www.communitech.ca/how-we-help/team-true-north/ , a comprehensive group of Canadian tech firms with performance and growth rates that match the top 1% of companies worldwide – companies with the highest probability of reaching $1 billion in annual revenue. We believe in tech for good, and establishing Canada as a preferred destination for growing careers wherever we can!
